caption: The drawing is monochromatic, rendered in shades of gray on a beige or off-white background. At the center of the composition is a rectangular framed relief depicting a scene with three human figures, a building, a boat, and some trees. The building is positioned to the left, appearing to be two stories tall with visible windows. In the middle, there is a boat with a curved prow and stern, containing two people, one of whom seems to be seated, while the other appears to be standing or leaning toward the seated figure. A third person stands just outside the boat on the right, interacting with the figures inside. Behind the boat are two trees with visible foliage, and there is vegetation or shrubbery in the lower part of the image. Below the scene, within the frame, there is an inscription in uppercase letters that reads: “HIS FLORIA SV VIA / MID DABILE CA N TVS.” The frame itself is plain, and the rest of the page is left blank, focusing attention on the central illustrated relief.
title: Pa. German Stove Plate
